about: The product holds, as data. Each key is a flag in src/v2/sim/features.ts; scripts/playtest.lint.test.js holds every `held` and `never-held` feature's DEFAULT_FEATURES value to false, and lets a hold become `lifted` only when a record under docs/playtests/ carries `verdict: "lift"` for it and is named in `liftedBy`. The protocol for producing such a record is docs/playtests/PROTOCOL.md.

statuses.held: Deliberately withheld pending playtest evidence. Requires heldOn, heldBy, source, reason.
statuses.never-held: Never formally decided either way. Requires note. Treated as held for the default.
statuses.lifted: A playtest record with verdict `lift` exists and is named. Requires liftedOn and liftedBy: [record ids]. Only then may the flag default on.
